name: vivien_minus_one_the_rest_go_to_the_bottom
note: Vivien, Nature's Avenger's -1: 'Reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card. Put that card into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.' P0's library from the top: Forest, Forest, Centaur Courser, Plains, then the runner's six creature fillers. The two Forests are revealed before the Courser: the Courser goes to the hand and both Forests under the library (their order is random; they share a name, so the exact list is fixed). Red before 2026-11-13 (with this record): the move of the Courser closed the reveal's window, so 'the rest' was the library's top card alone: one Forest went to the bottom and the other stayed on top.
